Assignment 3: Sentiment Classification Reflection

Open question

  1. Both MLP and LSTM model show overfitting. The loss decrease, and accuracy and f1 learning increase. Acc and F1 metrics plateau or fluctuate in early epochs and have a large gap between training and validation performance. Increasing dropout layers might can improve generalization to reduce the effect of overfitting. Using class weight can forced the model to think about the minority positive and negative classes that can increase the accuracy and F1.

  2. From the confusion matrixs of MLP and LSTM, MLP have more accurate than LSTM. In general, MLP is better. However, F1 and Sentiment Classification focus on the positive and negative class. In this case, LSTM is better model. Class 2 was most frequently misclassified. In the MLP matrix: 69 positives were misclassified as neutral with total 204, and 15 negatives were misclassified as neutral with total 91. In the LSTM matrix: 58 positives were misclassified as neutral, and 15 negatives were misclassified as neutral. There is around 29% of positives were misclassified as neutral, which is larger than others.

  1. Compared to sequence-based models, MLP model uses the mean of word vectors. In this way, model discard the sequence and structure. That might cause the positive and negative class misclassified. The MLP training curves show a large gap between train and val accuracy. LSTM model processing tokens as sequence provides advantages. By using a fixed 32-token input, the LSTM can classified the words by their position, and know the meaning more clearly. Bert and GPT are bettern than MLP and LSTM baselines. Bert have a huge number of accuracy with all the three classes. Training curve and val curve are very closed in GPT, and although there are gaps at the boundaries (at the beginning or the end), its performance is still good. BERT and GPT use dynamic embeddings that they will classified the meaning based on the sentences and surrounding words. Also these two model were pretrained on a huge datasets to understand grammer and logic. MLP and LSTM learn sentiment from scratch using limited data. I will rank these 6 model by the accuracy of words and learning curve. 1.bert 2.GPT 3.GRU 4.RNN 5.LSTM 6.MLP. Bert have the highest correctly classified counts. GPT have strong accuracy and good curve tend. GRU also have better accuracy than rest three.
